purpose: Acceptance matrix for the original Smriti benchmark/cost/growth request and the current ROADMAP. This is an evidence audit, not a completion or release claim.

overall.reason: Historical installed Mira v3/v4 reviews rejected parts of the scope/temporal quality pass; the current installed-v7 v5/generalization and corrected prior-tool reviews are bounded passes, with single-run and lexical/semantic limits recorded. Full-history LongMemEval-S50 QA, GBrain held-out20 semantic retrieval QA, and Hindsight comparative QA remain unfinished. A bounded frozen-v4 paired LoCoMo50 answer/judge baseline is complete for both adapters, but it is exploratory because of shared-conversation dependence and known judge/date errors.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Measure Smriti and local Mem0 over the same nomic 768-dimensional route at 100, 1,000, 3,000, 9,000, and 36,500 documents with durable timing, storage, restart/reopen, resubmission, and relevance evidence.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Benchmark persistent official-engine GBrain import/search without per-document CLI startup, and keep default untuned and ANALYZE-maintained observations separate.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: GBrain lexical has no embedding API cost and is not a semantic parity result.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Provide a separate real nomic GBrain semantic route with measured 768-dimensional vectors, metadata/vector-count validation, process-restart cold timing, and the same growth checkpoints.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: This does not close model-backed answer-quality evaluation; larger GBrain semantic QA remains pending.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Report measured cumulative ingest/query/storage observations and explicit 30/90/365-day cost scenarios, with local API $0 separated from unmeasured hardware cost and managed Mem0 pricing.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Render readable standard-matplotlib latency and storage curves for the matched/semantic tracks without inventing missing checkpoints.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: p50/p95 labels identify the empirical nearest-rank method; semantic GBrain and lexical GBrain remain distinct.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Record first query after ingest, cold reopen/restart boundary, warm p50/p95 sample counts, update/resubmit time, storage sidecars/cache, returned IDs/relevance, and model call/token/failure accounting without mocks.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: Smriti/Mem0 cold timing is a same-process client/database reopen; GBrain cold timing is a worker process restart.

acceptance_matrix.result: Smriti 27/50 (54%) and Mem0 26/50 (52%); 24 questions were correct for both, 21 for neither, 3 Smriti-only, and 2 Mem0-only. Exploratory paired question bootstrap for Smriti minus Mem0 was [-0.06, 0.10].
acceptance_matrix.caveat: The frozen-v4 pair does not establish superiority: questions share conversations, the bootstrap does not model that dependence, and the recorded judge labels include known errors including conv-30-q0.

explicit_nonclaims: The oracle LongMemEval retrieval files are not full-haystack answer quality.
The six-question preflight is not a leaderboard or significance result.
Local API cost $0 is shared across tested local routes and is not hardware cost $0.
Growth day labels are corpus equivalents at 100 adds/day, not calendar observations.
No universal Smriti superiority, zero-defect, or live-deployment claim is supported.
